## Summary

Describe the addition or correction.

## Checklist

- [ ] The paper is explicitly ES × LLM or ZO × LLM.
- [ ] The paper link is a primary source.
- [ ] The entry is in reverse chronological order.
- [ ] The description is original, factual, and one sentence long.
- [ ] Both English and Chinese metadata are present in `data/papers.json`.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/generate_catalog.py --check` passes.
- [ ] `papers.bib` is updated when applicable.
